text:
After having a very poor experience with a male gynaecologist at a hospital here last year, coming to Peach was a full 180 from that. Front desk was friendly and helpful, the whole clinic is clean, modern, and comfortable. The doctor answered all of my questions thoughtfully, with maturity, and gave me lots of helpful information. I had an exam and imaging done - all really comfortable, done with the utmost respect and I was talked through every step. The doctor gave me options, advice, and took my specific circumstances into account. There was absolutely no language barrier issues or misunderstandings from beginning to end.

All for less than the hospitals nearby, and for a far more positive/respectful experience. As farangs, when we hear the word clinic, we often presume it’s more expensive but this really was not. Would 100% recommend to anyone looking for a good affordable gynaecologist.

text:
I came to this clinic by recommendation of my friend. I had some traumatic experience with gynecologists before so it was very important to me to find a good clinic.
My first visit was very good — I had an emergency situation (as I thought) and the doctor took me without an appointment. I had ultrasound and blood test + consultation. The doctor was really nice and explained me everything very detailed. So I made an appointment for the following week specifically to the same doctor. It was important cause I didn't want to tell my story again to somebody else. Friday was full so I booked time for Saturday. It was my working day so I had to change my schedule. When I came on Saturday, I had to wait for 30 minutes after my time. I was 5 minutes late so maybe this was the reason. And when I finally was called, I found out it was another doctor, a person who I'd never seen before. I needed to discuss my blood test results so I stayed but it felt really uncomfortable. I had to tell my story again (which I really didn't want to do) and the doctor advised me the same medication which I didn't want to take. Well, it wasn't a nice experience, I was a bit sad and disappointed. The main thing was that receptionist or manager, whoever it is, didn't even tell me about the doctor change. She knew I asked for the exact doctor but I wasn't told before that there was another doctor.
